blocks.text:
After breakfast, transfer to El Dorado International Airport.

The flight to Cartagena is not included in the programme price.

On arrival, meet at Rafael Núñez International Airport and transfer to the hotel.

After check-in, a private panoramic tour of Cartagena begins in an air-conditioned vehicle.

The route includes the Bay of Cartagena, the Muelle de los Pegasos and the Manga neighbourhood, where you can see Moorish and Republican architecture.

Next, visit the Castillo de San Felipe de Barajas.

Then walk through the walled historic centre, with stops for craft shopping, the Church of San Pedro Claver and the Santo Domingo bastion.

Return to the hotel.

**Duration:** 4 hours.  
**Days:** daily.  
**Included:** a professional English-speaking guide, private transport and entrance fees to the listed sites.

blocks.text:
After breakfast, meet at the hotel and transfer to the Bodeguita pier.

Take a speedboat to the Rosario Islands. The crossing takes about 45 minutes.

Along the way, enjoy views of the Bay of Cartagena and Bocachica, as well as the forts of San Fernando and San José. After passing Barú Island, the boat arrives at one of the islands in the Rosario archipelago.

Enjoy free time by the sea. You can swim, relax on the beach or go scuba diving or snorkelling at an extra charge.

Return to Cartagena in the evening, then transfer to the hotel.

**Duration:** 8 hours.  
**Days:** daily.  
**Included:** a shared trip to the islands, hotel – pier – hotel transfers and a typical Caribbean lunch.  
**Not included:** Coralia tax of $10 per person and oceanarium admission of $10 per person.
